mixer.label: Color Mixer
mixer.blurb: Mix paints in the cauldron and color the pictures
mixer.intro: The picture is still gray — it needs coloring! Pour two paints into the magic cauldron to get the color you need.

introFor.1: Now there are white and black paints. White makes a color lighter, and black makes it darker.
introFor.2: The trickiest colors come when you mix a ready-made color with another one. Have a go!

prompt: The {at} must turn {mix}. Which two paints should you mix?
hint: You get {mix} if you mix {a} and {b} paint.
